entries.en: Fixed Bash commands failing with "task output swap refused (tasks dir moved or linked)" on some Macs
entries.zh: 修复了某些 Mac 上的 Bash 命令因“任务输出交换被拒绝（任务目录已移动或链接）”而失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed "always allow" not saving in a project that has no .claude/settings.local.json yet
entries.zh: 修复了“始终允许”不保存在还没有 .claude/settings.local.json 的项目中的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions hosted by Claude Desktop or VS Code stalling for minutes after a tool finished when the connection to claude.ai was degraded
entries.zh: 修复了当与 claude.ai 的连接降级时，工具完成后由 Claude Desktop 或 VS Code 托管的远程控制会话会停滞几分钟的问题

entries.en: Fixed background task notifications with very large failure output (for example git errors on a full disk) making the conversation exceed the API request size limit
entries.zh: 修复了具有非常大的失败输出（例如完整磁盘上的 git 错误）的后台任务通知，导致对话超出 API 请求大小限制
